import hashlib,json,re,runpy,sys
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__
ns=runpy.run_path('/Users/sheny/Developer/code/Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-Python/tests/test_pdf_long_toc.py')
results={}
for columns in (1,2):
 for chinese in (False,True):
  for shaping in (False,True):
   model,tokens=ns['long_toc_model'](columns,chinese)
   options=aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions();options.text_shaping=shaping;options.export_document_structure=True
   raw=ns['LdmPdfWriter'](options).write_to_bytes(model)
   key=f'{columns}-{chinese}-{shaping}'
   with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
    text=re.sub(r'\s+','',''.join(p.get_text() for p in pdf))
    pages=[]
    for p in pdf:
     pages.append({'words':p.get_text('words'),'pixel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.get_pixmap().samples).hexdigest()})
    results[key]={'source_tokens':tokens,'actual_text':text,'expected_text':''.join(tokens)+'999AFTER','all_content_preserved':text==''.join(tokens)+'999AFTER','complete_title_token_count':sum(t in text for t in tokens),'bytes':len(raw),'pages':pages}
    if key=='2-True-True':
     pdf.save('/tmp/docweave-long-toc-'+sys.argv[1]+'.pdf')
     pdf[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(3,3)).save('/tmp/docweave-long-toc-'+sys.argv[1]+'.png')
Path('/tmp/docweave-long-toc-'+sys.argv[1]+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print({k:{'preserved':v['all_content_preserved'],'tokens':v['complete_title_token_count'],'pages':len(v['pages'])} for k,v in results.items()})
